Fix the currency rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py` where JPY amounts receive two decimal places. PDF export migration is superseded/paused; continue with small commits.

Invoice report query optimization and batch currency conversion are complete but uncommitted. Tests: 18 invoice-summary tests passed, broader reports 63 passed and 2 skipped, Ruff clean. Profiling improved tenant 73 from roughly 39 seconds to 4.46 seconds; query count is 37.

PDF work is also uncommitted: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py` now includes negative credit lines, uses shared `format_money`, and has regression tests.
